events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Multiple sources indicate Deepwater has had quiet conversations with at least two teams about moving assets before the season. Nothing close to filed. But the board pressure is real, and Mitchum is not operating on his own timeline anymore.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Dina's Deepwater report has me in a CHOKEHOLD. Someone give me a segment. Give me twelve minutes and a dry-erase board. Mitchum at $68.70 going into a season where he still hasn't told us what the roster IS. I need to talk about this.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Helix roster right now is like a house where someone finally put up real walls — Herbert is load-bearing, Mitchell gives you a ground floor, and the TE room is still an open ceiling with exposed wiring. Functional. Survivable. Not finished.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley made sixteen trades last season, won nothing, and is sitting at +6.8% this offseason. Adam made two trades, acquired a franchise quarterback, and the whole market is calling it a rebuild. Inactivity is just active patience with better branding.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I will say this about Adam and I will say it once: the Herbert deal is defensible. The 2028 first is painful and the TE room is a liability and the model still has to prove itself on the field. But defensible. That is not a word I use lightly around here.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Atlas is at $44.38. Colbie Young off waivers replaced Joe Mixon who was already a free agent. Drew dropped a running back with no current team for a wide receiver with no current leverage. I'm not yelling. I genuinely don't know what to do with that information.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: The conversation about Helix keeps starting and stopping at Herbert, which makes sense, but Keaton Mitchell arriving in the same window matters. You need a backfield in this format. A superflex QB is the engine — the RB is who keeps the engine from overheating. Mitchell is underrated in that context.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Tonight's Exchange Report: Dina's Deepwater sourcing, the Helix valuation debate, and I've been told Bo will be 'brief' on the Mitchum situation. We have allotted him four minutes. He has already requested eleven. Seven PM.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Monarch's WR surplus problem is getting mainstream attention now. Great. I wrote about the illiquidity risk before the draft. The format punishes roster imbalance quietly and then all at once — Shaq is about to find out what all at once feels like.
